LESSON: AFRICAN DIASPORAS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Development and Governance
Topic 5.4: African Diasporas

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: African Diasporas
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we promote collaboration between continental Africans and African Diasporas?
